Information.Description: Flutamide can cause developmental toxicity according to state or federal government labeling requirements.
Information.DescriptionSourceName: California Office of Environmental Health Hazard Assessment (OEHHA)

Information.Description: Flutamide is a monocarboxylic acid amide and a member of (trifluoromethyl)benzenes. It has a role as an androgen antagonist and an antineoplastic agent.
